use default

use PIECE = (text: string, separator: string, at: int)

starts_with(text: string, position: int, separator: string) -> bool =>
    position + separator.length <= text.length /\
        text[position..position + separator.length] =~ separator

multisplit(text: string, separators: string[]) -> Pipe[PIECE] is
    let start mut = 0
    let position mut = 0

    while position < text.length do
        if let separator = separators
            |> find(candidate => starts_with(text, position, candidate))
        then
            yield (text = text[start..position],
                   separator = separator, at = position)

            position = position + separator.length
            start = position
        else
            position = position + 1
        fi
    od

    yield (text = text[start..text.length], separator = "", at = -1)
si

let pieces = multisplit("a!===b=!=c", ["==", "!=", "="])
    |> collect_list()

write_line(pieces
    |> map(piece => "\"{piece.text}\"")
    |> join(", "))

pieces
    |> filter(piece => piece.separator.length > 0)
    |> each(piece =>
        write_line("matched {piece.separator} at {piece.at}"))

use PIECE = (text: string, separator: string, at: int)

starts_with(text: string, position: int, separator: string) -> bool =>
    position + separator.length <= text.length /\
        text[position..position + separator.length] =~ separator

multisplit(text: string, separators: string[]) -> Pipe[PIECE] is
    let start mut = 0
    let position mut = 0

    while position < text.length do
        if let separator = separators
            |> find(candidate => starts_with(text, position, candidate))
        then
            yield (text = text[start..position],
                   separator = separator, at = position)

            position = position + separator.length
            start = position
        else
            position = position + 1
        fi
    od

    yield (text = text[start..text.length], separator = "", at = -1)
si

let pieces = multisplit("a!===b=!=c", ["==", "!=", "="])
    |> collect_list()

write_line(pieces
    |> map(piece => "\"{piece.text}\"")
